title: Session handoff: after GCLI-10 lands (opum-workflow renewal)
description: Session handoff for the opum-workflow renewal of 2026-10-21, written after GCLI-10 slice 2 landed (opum-ai/glyph-cli#38, squash 77505f8). Record-only, carried in the same tracker-only PR as the round-2 verdict and the two follow-ups. The successor's first tracker action is to complete GCLI-10, then take GCLI-18.
implementationNotes:
SESSION HANDOFF (opum-workflow renewal, 2026-10-21, later half). GCLI-10 slice 2 is landed; the successor's first tracker action is to complete it, then pick up GCLI-18. LANDED: GCLI-10, opum-ai/glyph-cli#38, squash 77505f81bc861d3c52d1b1cc6aa890ef08e6fb39. Round 2 was APPROVED with no BLOCKING or MAJOR; the verdict is recorded verbatim on GCLI-10 (reviewer model deepseek-flash, 53 requests), naming the reviewed SHA 827ae1df10ac146e6540d5381842f568877d7547, the SHA landed after merging dev 1c78eefd4d7d82e9f6b86da35c4c2f279790e766, and the verdict file's sha256 bc038b2eb4973d27743e1be3fc2cc54d12d311bef3cbb2f29896b1dd9dfe2341. What landed: src/impact.ts (reverse closure, deterministic shortest path by codepoint order, exact truncation, SCC cycles, module-scope terminal callers at true depth), src/snapshot.ts (commit tree from ls-tree plus one cat-file batch, in-memory compiler host, no in-repo node_modules reads per DEC-216 (a2), the tool's own TS lib dir the only in-repo disk read), the ref cache key from the listing, src/program.ts wiring, src/contract.ts registry, tests, README, ADR 0003, and the CLAUDE.md profile line.

GCLI-19 (low) -- findings 2-4 and NITs 5-7 grouped: stale README transcript, the `one-site path` wording (a2) replaced, the absolute two-machine claim versus the cache key and outside-root reads, posix() mangling backslash paths, and two README wordings. NIT 8 is already GCLI-16. Wait for the orchestrator's clear before merging #42.

TRACKER: GCLI-10 In Progress, land done, acceptance criteria met per both reviews -- complete it next with a final summary naming #38 and the squash, unless the orchestrator says otherwise. GCLI-15 To Do (worktree indexing; one-line .gitignore remedy). GCLI-16 Done (profile exit family, #40). GCLI-11, GCLI-12, GCLI-13, GCLI-14 To Do; GCLI-11 is slice 3 (imports and implements/extends), not yet planned. GCLI-18 is the highest-ranked open follow-up.

DEC-208 says leave them; nothing here removes them. They are untracked and unignored, so working-tree discovery indexes them on this host (GCLI-15): `glyph callers buildIndex` is ambiguous locally, while `--ref` is clean.

CAUTIONS: docs run under the pinned lore 0.13.0 (npm exec --yes --package @opum-ai/lore@0.13.0 -- lore ...); global lore 0.14.1 drifts. `bun run format` fails on the nested worktrees; use `bunx biome format --write src test`. Local main is stale behind origin; promote only from origin/dev, never local dev, with `git push origin origin/dev:main`. Merge dev into a branch, never rebase. No decision is pending from a person; nothing is blocked.

CORRECTION to the handoff note above (recorded under GCLI-16, 2026-10-22): the session handoff says 'GCLI-16 Done (profile exit family, #40)'. That is wrong and GCLI-16 is To Do and genuinely open. What PR opum-ai/glyph-cli#40 delivered was filing the follow-up (the tracker-only record commit 4077f81); the profile sentence in CLAUDE.md was NOT corrected by it. The stale sentence still reads 'exit 0/1/2/3' against errors.ts's full frozen family (0 ok, 1 uncaught, 2 usage, 3 not_found, 4 denied, 5 conflict, 6 validation/drift, 7 indeterminate). The correction is being made under GCLI-16 itself, in the same branch and pull request as this note, so the handoff's error is repaired rather than carried forward to the next successor.
finalSummary: Session handoff recorded in the note: GCLI-10 landed at #38 (squash 77505f8) and awaits completion; GCLI-18 high and GCLI-19 low filed in this same tracker-only PR; GCLI-15 To Do; round-2 verdict and both SHAs on GCLI-10; worktrees and cautions named.
